reason: intentional divergence (decisions 65 and 106): MX data attribute tags are plain values (`{ ...attrs, content }`, or arrays of them); a declared callee gets a positioned compile error for `<${x}/>`, and an untyped callee gets `MX: this value is a data attribute tag ({ ...attrs, content }); render its body with <${x.content}/>`; Marko 6 exposes bare renderables through its attribute-tag record
